newsitem.title: USA: Alco Standard sees record growth for Ikon.
newsitem.headline: Alco Standard sees record growth for Ikon.

text.p: Alco Standard Corp said Wednesday it sees record growth for its continuing operation, Ikon Office Solutions, for fiscal 1997.

For the year ended September 30, Alco said, Ikon had record revenues of $4.1 billion, up 33 percent from 1995. Income was also a new high -- $165 million, a 43 percent increase over the $115 million posted in fiscal 1995. Earnings per share from continuing operations were $1.12, a 30 percent increase over 1995 on a 9.6 percent increase in average shares outstanding.

For the fourth quarter, Ikon revenues increased 31 percent to $1.1 billion. Income grew 44 percent to $44 million. Earnings per share were $0.30, a 50 percent increase over the same period of fiscal 1995, despite a 12 percent increase in average shares outstanding.

"Ikon's performance reflects impressive internal growth, plus our continuing focus on acquisitions," commented John E. Stuart, Alco's chief executive. "Internal revenue growth, which excludes acquisitions, was 15 percent for the quarter."
Ikon completed 100 acquisitions in fiscal 1996, including 29 in the fourth fiscal quarter. Annualized revenues of the acquired companies total nearly $900 million.
"We've brought some impressive companies into the Ikon fold this past year," Stuart said.
"These fine new companies, along with continued internal growth, will spur Ikon to record growth again in fiscal 1997."

Including discontinued operations, Alco reported $211 million in net income and $1.48 earnings per share for the year. Discontinued operations also reflect a pre-tax charge of $18 million taken in the third quarter for the spinoff of Unisource Worldwide Inc, which is expected to be completed by December 31.
